name: X-Rite
tagline: The global leader in color science and measurement technology.
description: X-Rite is the global leader in color science and technology. The company develops, manufactures, markets and supports innovative color solutions through measurement systems, software, color standards and services.

name: GMG
tagline: High-end color management and proofing software solutions.
description: GMG is a leading developer and supplier of high-end color management software solutions, specializing in contract proofing, digital print optimization, and standardized press reproduction.

name: GlobalVision
tagline: Automated proofreading and quality inspection systems.
description: GlobalVision provides automated quality control solutions that inspect text, artwork, barcodes, and braille throughout the packaging workflow, eliminating human error.

name: Hybrid Software
tagline: Enterprise prepress automation and packaging workflow software.
description: Hybrid Software develops innovative productivity tools for the graphic arts industry, including Cloudflow enterprise prepress workflow and Packz native PDF packaging editor.

name: Phoenix M.I.S + IoT
tagline: Proprietary shopfloor intelligence and print management systems.
description: Phoenix M.I.S + IoT is Phoenix Colour Technologies' proprietary shopfloor intelligence platform connecting press machinery, ERP systems, and QA instruments for real-time OEE and yield optimization.

name: Miraclon
tagline: Home of KODAK FLEXCEL Solutions for flexographic printing.
description: Miraclon is the home of KODAK FLEXCEL Solutions, which have helped transform flexographic printing into a premium, consistent, and cost-effective packaging production process.

name: EIZO
tagline: ColorEdge professional color-accurate monitors.
description: EIZO manufactures high-end visual technology including the ColorEdge series of color management monitors engineered for prepress proofing, photography, and film post-production.

name: Valiani
tagline: Precision digital die cutting and packaging prototyping systems.
description: Valiani designs and manufactures precision flatbed digital cutting tables and software for packaging prototyping, short-run packaging conversion, and digital die cutting.

name: IGT
tagline: Printability testing equipment and laboratory instruments.
description: IGT Testing Systems produces high-precision testing equipment for the paper, printing, ink, and plastic industries to evaluate printability, tack, penetration, and rub resistance.

name: Inkmaker
tagline: Integrated automated dispensing and ink dosing systems.
description: Inkmaker is a global manufacturer of automated dispensing systems and industrial plant engineering for liquid ink, paint, coatings, and chemical formulation.

name: Just Normlicht
tagline: Standardized lighting solutions according to ISO 3664:2009.
description: Just Normlicht develops visual color assessment lighting equipment, proof stations, and LED light booths strictly adhering to international ISO 3664 standards.

name: Hanatek Instruments
tagline: Physical packaging testing and substrate assessment instruments.
description: Hanatek manufactures physical test equipment for packaging materials, assessing crease recovery, friction coefficients, tensile properties, and carton stiffness.

name: Siegwerk
tagline: Global market leader in printing inks and sustainable coatings.
description: Siegwerk is one of the world's leading manufacturers of printing inks and coatings for packaging applications and labels, with bespoke color formulation services.

name: Apex International
tagline: World-class anilox rolls and sleeve measurement solutions.
description: Apex International is the global leader in anilox roll and sleeve manufacturing, utilizing patented GTT genetic transfer technology for superior ink transfer consistency.

name: Epson
tagline: UltraChrome precision proofing and large format printing.
description: Epson provides industry-standard UltraChrome PRO pigment ink printers utilized worldwide for ISO 12647 contract proofing, packaging mockup generation, and fine art reproduction.

name: Luster
tagline: High-speed 100% inline print inspection and machine vision.
description: Luster LightTech develops machine vision systems, offering 100% inline surface and print inspection for web presses, sheetfed printing, and flexible packaging converting.

name: Pantone
tagline: The world's universal language of color for brand consistency.
description: Pantone provides a universal language of color that enables color-critical decisions through every stage of the workflow for brands and manufacturers across graphic arts and textiles.

name: EngView Systems
tagline: CAD/CAM solutions for packaging and POP/POS displays.
description: EngView Systems develops specialized CAD/CAM software for structural design of corrugated packaging, folding cartons, and point-of-sale displays.

name: PrintFactory
tagline: Cloud-connected workflow and color management ecosystem.
description: PrintFactory is a production-suite software for wide-format and industrial digital printing, delivering centralized color consistency and significant ink savings.

name: ECO3
tagline: Prepress solutions, offset printing plates, and screening.
description: ECO3 is a global provider of prepress systems and offset printing plates, combining hardware, chemistry-free thermal plates, and workflow software.

name: StudioRIP
tagline: Feature-rich, high-performance raster image processing (RIP).
description: StudioRIP produces versatile raster image processing solutions engineered for flexo, offset, screen, and digital printing with advanced screening engines.
